title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
source: AUD mC> Rx2> DAT> CDR; this new version has been pitch adjusted with the following ratios: acoustic set with a 'slight' sliding time scale/pitch shift of +0.123%; 2) electric set with a sliding time scale/pitch shift of +9.678%; (electric [lower volume level] set has also been amplified by +3.9%)

ai_review.summary: Excellent multi‑source recording captures a historic acoustic/electric show featuring the first Ripple and Broke Down Palace performances.
ai_review.review: The release delivers a crystal‑clear mix that balances direct acoustic detail with a richly enhanced electric 7‑channel sound, while preserving the priceless audience ambience. Fans rave about the setlist – especially the debut recordings of "Ripple" and "Broke Down Palace" – and praise Jerry Garcia’s three‑instrument versatility throughout the evening.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, highlighting an outstanding performance and a high‑quality recording; limited number of reviews lowers confidence to medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Combines direct acoustic settings with a 7‑channel enhanced electric mix; audience ambience is highlighted as priceless, no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The acoustic/electric format is praised as a gift from the gods, with seamless transitions that showcase the band’s diverse material and evolution.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted for playing three different instruments across the acoustic and electric sets.
